visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Reading Does Not Refresh the Entry
visualizerParams.problemDescription: After a is read, b should be evicted and the cache should hold ['a', 'c'], but it holds ['b', 'c'].

solution.code:
from collections import OrderedDict


class LRUCache:
    def __init__(self, capacity):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.items = OrderedDict()

    def get(self, key):
        if key not in self.items:
            return -1
        self.items.move_to_end(key)
        return self.items[key]

    def put(self, key, value):
        self.items[key] = value
        self.items.move_to_end(key)
        if len(self.items) > self.capacity:
            self.items.popitem(last=False)


cache = LRUCache(2)
cache.put("a", 1)
cache.put("b", 2)
cache.get("a")
cache.put("c", 3)
print(list(cache.items))
solution.explanation: The cache evicts the entry that was used least recently. If get does not move the key to the end, reading a does not count as a use, so a (inserted first) is evicted instead of b.
